title: Transplantation of UC-MSCs on a collagen scaffold restores ovarian function in mice with POF
author: Yanjun Yang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rnzd5f6
materials: At passage 3, the cells were assessed for multipotency using adipogenic, osteogenic and neural-like differentiation assays. Briefly, cells were cultured in adipogenic induction medium (GIBCO) for 14 days. Oil red O staining (Sigma, Steinheim, Germany) was used as an indicator of intracellular lipid accumulation. Osteogenesis was induced by osteogenic induction medium (GIBCO) for 28 days and calcium deposition was observed via alizarin red staining (Sigma). Cells were treated with the pre-induction medium containing 10-7 M all-trans-retinoic acid (ATRA; Sigma) and 10 ng/ml bFGF (GIBCO) for 24 h, and then treated with modified MNM medium for 36 h for neural-like differentiation. The expression of neuron-speciﬁc enolase (1:100, sc-292097, Santa Cruz Biotechnology, Santa Cruz, CA, USA) and neuroﬁlament medium polypeptide (1:100, sc-16143, Santa Cruz Biotechnology) in induced UC-MSCs was detected by immunoﬂuorescence staining.
Preparation of the premature ovarian failure mouse model.

Ovaries were fixed in 10% buffered-formalin for 12 h. After embedded and sectioned at 5 μm, samples were deparaffinized, rehydrated, and endogenous peroxidase activity was blocked by incubation in Reagent A/B (Sangon, China) for 10 min. Tissue samples were immunolabeled with anti-Ki67 antibody (Ki67, 1:400, ab16667, Abcam, Cambridge, UK) and anti-Cleaved-Caspase3 antibody (Cleaved-Caspase3, 1:300, 9661, Cell Signaling Technology, Beverly, MA, USA) overnight at 4 ℃. The sections were then washed 3 times in PBS, incubated with goat anti rabbit secondary antibody and stained with DAB reagent (Zhongshan Jinqiao Biotechnology Co, Ltd, Beijing, China). Primary antibodies were replaced with non-immune rabbit IgG in some sections to serve as the negative control.

steps.title: Isolate and culture UC-MSCs
steps.instruction: Isolate human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells (UC-MSCs) from tissues collected within 12 h of normal vaginal delivery.

substeps.instruction: Mechanically remove vessels from the umbilical cord.
Manually dissect the cord into small sections.
Culture sections in complete growth medium: low-glucose Dulbecco’s modified Eagle’s medium (LG-DMEM) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS), 100 U/mL penicillin, and 100 mg/mL streptomycin.
Observe first colony after approximately 14 days.
Use UC-MSCs at passages 3-5 for subsequent experiments.

steps.title: Analyze UC-MSC surface markers
steps.instruction: Perform flow cytometry on passage 3 UC-MSCs to analyze surface marker expression.

substeps.instruction: Incubate cells for 1 h with FITC- or PE-conjugated antibodies against human CD13, CD29, CD34, CD45, CD73, CD90, CD105, CD146, and HLA-DR.

steps.title: Prepare collagen/UC-MSC scaffolds
steps.instruction: Create gelatinous collagen type I scaffolds and seed them with UC-MSCs.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 20 mg of collagen type I in 2 mL PBS and pipette repeatedly to form gelatinous scaffolds.
Seed UC-MSCs on the collagen scaffold in 24-well plates to achieve a final concentration of 5 mg/ml of degradable collagen mixed with UC-MSCs.
Keep transplant components on ice and mix immediately prior to injection.

steps.title: Induce POF in mice
steps.instruction: Induce premature ovarian failure (POF) in 6-week-old female C57BL/6 mice.

substeps.instruction: Verify normal estrus cycles via daily vaginal smears (2 consecutive normal 4-day cycles).
Administer CTX at 40 mg/kg/day intraperitoneally for 15 days.
Administer an equal volume of sterile water to control group mice.

steps.title: Transplant materials into ovaries
steps.instruction: Inject treatment suspensions into the core of the ovaries of POF mice.

substeps.instruction: Anesthetize mice with chloral hydrate (4 ml/kg), fix in decubitus position, and shave the back.
Expose ovaries through a micro-incision on the back.
Inject 10 μl aliquots into the core of the ovaries in a retrograde manner through the maximum ovary cross-section using 0.33-mm (29G) needles (BD Ultra-Fine 1.0-ml disposable insulin syringes).
Apply treatment based on group: PBS (10 μl PBS), Collagen (10 μl degradable collagen), UC-MSC (2×10^5 UC-MSCs in 10 μl PBS), or Collagen/UC-MSC (2×10^5 UC-MSCs in 10 μl degradable collagen).

steps.title: Monitor and collect plasma
steps.instruction: Monitor estrus cycles and collect blood for hormone analysis four weeks post-transplantation.

substeps.instruction: Obtain daily vaginal smears for 2 consecutive estrus cycles starting two weeks after injection.
Anesthetize mice with chloral hydrate during diestrus four weeks after transplantation.
Collect blood from the posterior orbital venous plexus.
Centrifuge blood and freeze plasma at -80°C.
Measure FSH and E2 using YANYU ELISA kit and AMH using CEA228Mu Cloud-Clone Corp ELISA kit.

steps.title: Perform histological analysis of ovaries
steps.instruction: Process and stain ovaries for follicle counting.

substeps.instruction: Remove ovaries and fix in Bouin’s solution for 4-6 h.
Dehydrate and embed samples in paraffin.
Trim ovarian area and slice into 5 μm thick sections.
Stain every fifth section with hematoxylin and eosin (HE).
Count follicles containing an oocyte nucleus using an unbiased stereological method and multiply the total by five.
